abstract: A third edition of An economic history of Europe has now appeared, with Markus Lampe joining the late Karl Gunnar Persson and his protégé Paul Sharp as a co-author. The book has by this point established itself as a widely used synthesis of European economic history for undergraduate economics students, and this new edition invites the simple question, ‘what has actually changed?’.
abstract_zh: 《欧洲经济史》第三版现已问世，马库斯·兰佩加入了已故的卡尔·贡纳尔·佩尔松及其门生保罗·夏普的行列，成为合著者。此书至此已成为经济学本科生广泛使用的欧洲经济史综合教材，而这一新版引出了一个简单的问题：“究竟有何变化？
title: An economic history of Europe: Knowledge, institutions and welfare, prehistory to the present Karl Gunnar Persson, Paul Sharp, and Markus Lampe, (3rd edition, Cambridge University Press, 2026. Pp. 314. ISBN 9781009613989. Sbk £35).
title_zh: 欧洲经济史：知识、制度与福利——从史前到当代

abstract: Few questions in economic history feel more urgent in 2026 than those posed at the opening of this volume. That is, when one country tries to damage another's trade or resources, what results are to be expected, why have those results so often been disappointed, and can economic measures be effective if unaccompanied by force, or the credible threat of it? Professors Stephen Broadberry and Mark Harrison, whose previous collaborations on the economics of the two world wars set the standard for the field, have assembled a team of leading scholars to look for answers across three centuries. The result is a volume that is at once both a worthy successor to those earlier collections and a distinctive intervention in current debates about the use of sanctions against Iran, Russia, China, and others. It complements the recent work of Nicholas Mulder (The economic weapon, 2022) and Lance Davis and Stanley Engerman (Naval blockades in peace and war, 2006) by extending the chronology and broadening the comparative framework.
abstract_zh: 在2026年，经济史中几乎没有比本卷开篇提出的问题更为紧迫的了。即，当一个国家试图损害另一国的贸易或资源时，预期会产生何种结果，为何这些结果常常令人失望，以及如果经济措施没有武力或可信武力威胁的伴随，它们能否有效？斯蒂芬·布罗德伯里教授和马克·哈里森教授，他们此前在两次世界大战经济学方面的合作树立了该领域的标杆，现已召集了一支顶尖学者团队，跨越三个世纪寻找答案。其结果是一部既是对早期文集当之无愧的继承，又是对当前关于对伊朗、俄罗斯、中国等国制裁辩论的独特介入之作。它通过延长时间跨度和拓宽比较框架，补充了尼古拉斯·穆尔德（《经济武器》，2022年）和兰斯·戴维斯与斯坦利·恩格尔曼（《和平与战争中的海上封锁》，2006年）近期的研究。

title: Economic warfare and sanctions since 1688 Stephen Broadberry and Mark Harrison, Eds., (Cambridge University Press, 2025. Pp. 298. ISBN 9781009474863. PbK £28).
title_zh: 《1688年以来的经济战与制裁》

abstract: In Two Paths to Prosperity, Greif, Mokyr, and Tabellini (GMT) apply their formidable analytical powers to explaining the divergent trajectories followed by China and Western Europe. In the book's conclusion it is observed that, while much of the economic history literature is focused on the persistence of differences between societies, over the very long run historical reversals have also existed (p.468). Two Paths to Prosperity discusses such a reversal: the shift in the world's centre of economic gravity away from and then back towards China. GMT's description of their book as ‘a study of comparative economic history’ (p. 454) is simultaneously accurate and excessively modest. As I will set out in this short review, the book excels as such a study and so much more. I can only touch on a fraction of the many novel arguments they develop, however.
abstract_zh: 在《通往繁荣的两条路径》中，Greif、Mokyr与Tabellini（简称GMT）运用其卓越的分析能力，阐释了中国与西欧所遵循的迥异发展轨迹。该书结论部分指出，尽管经济史文献多聚焦于社会间差异的持续性，但在极长的时间跨度内，历史逆转现象亦曾存在（第468页）。《通往繁荣的两条路径》探讨了这样一种逆转：世界经济重心先远离中国，后又回归中国的转变。GMT将其著作描述为“一项比较经济史研究”（第454页），这一表述既准确又过于谦逊。正如本短评所述，该书作为此类研究堪称典范，其内涵远不止于此。然而，我只能触及他们提出的众多新颖论点中的一小部分。

title: Two paths to prosperity: Culture and institutions in Europe and China, 1000–2000 Avner Greif, Joel Mokyr, and Guido Tabellini, (Princeton University Press, 2025. Pp. 533. ISBN 9780691265940. Hbk £35).
title_zh: 两条通往繁荣之路：欧洲与中国的文化与制度，1000–2000年

abstract: Using China's expansion of the high-speed rail system (HSR) as a quasi-natural experiment, we analyze the comprehensive vehicle registration data from 2010 to 2023 to estimate the causal impact of HSR connectivity on the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs).Implementing several identification strategies, including staggered difference-in-differences (DID), Callaway and Sant'Anna (CS) DID, and two instrumental-variable approaches, we consistently find that, by alleviating range anxiety, the expansion of HSR can account for up to one third of the increase in EV market share and EV sales in China during our sample period, with effects particularly pronounced in cities served by faster HSR lines.The results remain robust when controlling for local industrial policies, charging infrastructure growth, supply-side factors, and economic development.We also find that HSR connectivity amplifies the effectiveness of charging infrastructure and consumer purchase subsidies in promoting EV adoption.
abstract_zh: 以中国高铁系统扩张作为准自然实验，我们分析了2010年至2023年的综合车辆登记数据，以估计高铁连通性对电动汽车采用率的因果影响。通过实施多种识别策略，包括交错双重差分法（DID）、Callaway和Sant'Anna（CS）DID以及两种工具变量方法，我们一致发现，通过缓解里程焦虑，高铁扩张可解释样本期内中国电动汽车市场份额及销量增长的三分之一，且这一效应在高铁线路速度更快的城市尤为显著。在控制地方产业政策、充电基础设施增长、供给侧因素及经济发展水平后，结果依然稳健。我们还发现，高铁连通性增强了充电基础设施和消费者购车补贴在促进电动汽车采用方面的有效性。

title: High-speed rail and China’s electric vehicle adoption miracle
title_zh: 高铁与中国电动汽车普及奇迹

abstract: We propose a framework to disentangle the quantile treatment effect of a binary treatment at a specific rank into an indirect quantile treatment effect that operates through a mediator and an unmediated direct quantile treatment effect. We establish identification results for these effects under the sequential ignorability assumption and propose double/debiased machine learning estimators, based on the efficient influence functions of the cumulative distribution functions of potential outcomes. We demonstrate uniform consistency and asymptotic normality of our effect estimators under specific regularity conditions and propose a multiplier bootstrap for statistical inference. Finally, we apply our method to data from the National Job Corps Study to assess the direct effect of training on earnings and the indirect effect operating through work experience.
title: Estimation of Direct and Indirect Quantile Treatment Effects with Double Machine Learning
title_zh: 基于双重机器学习的直接与间接分位数处理效应估计

abstract: We nonparametrically identify Type I and Type II error rates when mistakes are unobserved. Our strategy reframes the setting as a misclassified binary choice model, using a special regressor to identify the misclassification probabilities. Identification requires an exclusion restriction and a large support condition. When the exclusion restriction is in doubt, we show how our estimands can be interpreted as bounds under a weaker monotonicity condition. Bounds are also provided when the large support condition is violated. We apply our method to estimate miscarriages of justice in Virginia. Among defendants who proceeded to trial, the estimated probability of wrongful acquittal ranges from 18 to 42%, depending on offense type, race, and gender. Our method also produces estimates of wrongful conviction probabilities; however, these are very high, potentially reflecting the restriction of our sample to trial defendants and/or violations of key assumptions.
title: Using a Special Regressor to Identify Type I and Type II Error Probabilities, With an Illustrative Application to Miscarriages of Justice
title_zh: 使用特殊回归变量识别第一类与第二类错误概率：以司法误判为例的实证分析

abstract: Using age-specific measures as proxies for lifetime outcomes can introduce bias into estimates of intergenerational associations. We extend the generalized errors-in-variables (GEiV) model to the estimation of intergenerational crime associations and implement a data-driven method to correct for life-cycle bias. The GEiV adjustment accounts for both the extensive and intensive margins and introduces an elasticity estimator that accommodates zeros. Our results show that intergenerational associations are underestimated by 30–50%, even when criminal behaviors are measured during the teenage years, a period least affected by life-cycle bias. The GEiV-adjusted intergenerational elasticity between fathers and sons in New Zealand is approximately 0.7 for the likelihood of committing any crime and 0.5 for the number of crimes committed. Mother–child elasticities are smaller than father–child elasticities. The GEiV-adjusted estimates remain stable across ages, birth cohorts, number of aggregated years, and crime types and severity.
title: Life-Cycle Bias Adjustment and Intergenerational Association in Crime
title_zh: 犯罪中的生命周期偏差修正与代际关联

abstract: The study focuses on the analysis of neutral states' exports to the Russian Federation via SDID and their comparison with more diligent enforcers of European sanctions, emphasising thus the changes that took place after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The investigation seeks to identify if the invasion and its subsequent repercussions resulted in significant changes in the commodity structure of trade of the neutral states, indicating their engagement in sanction‐busting behaviour. The research is based on 13 synthetic difference‐in‐difference panel data models for each sampled state using data from the UN Comtrade database. The results highlight an increase in the value of sanctioned commodities exported to Russia in all nine instances, where a significant change occurred solely in Kazakhstan and Türkiye. The findings of the study are consistent with the existing literature, and they reveal several directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中立国通过SDID向俄罗斯联邦的出口情况，并将其与更严格执行欧洲制裁的国家进行对比，重点分析了2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后发生的变化。研究旨在探究此次入侵及其后续影响是否导致中立国贸易商品结构发生显著变化，从而揭示其参与规避制裁的行为。研究基于联合国商品贸易统计数据库的数据，为每个样本国家构建了13个合成双重差分面板数据模型。结果显示，在所有9个案例中，向俄罗斯出口的受制裁商品价值均有所增加，其中仅哈萨克斯坦和土耳其出现了显著变化。研究结论与现有文献一致，并为未来研究指明了若干方向。
title: Friend or Foe? Analysing Neutral States' Exports to the Russian Federation Using Synthetic Difference‐In‐Differences
title_zh: 朋友还是敌人？利用合成双重差分法分析中立国对俄罗斯联邦的出口

abstract: Investigating the dynamic linkage between international crude oil prices and stock markets is crucial for mitigating cross-market systemic risks. Based on weekly data from 11 January 2002, to 13 October 2023, this paper develops an integrated analytical framework combining wavelet decomposition, DCC-GARCH, and quantile time-frequency spillover methods to systematically examine the oil – stock nexus. The main findings are as follows: First, the correlation between oil prices and stock returns exhibits significant frequency dependence. In the short term, the correlation is positive, whereas it turns negative in the long term. Second, the relationship between oil price changes and stock markets varies with the underlying drivers of oil price shocks. Demand-driven oil price increases are primarily associated with positive correlations, whereas supply-driven increases are more often associated with negative correlations. Third, VIX is positively associated with market co-movement, while GPR shows the opposite effect. Fourth, the correlation between oil prices and U.S. stocks is stronger than that between oil prices and Chinese stocks, possibly reflecting China’s policy interventions and differences in market structure. Moreover, the U.S. stock market is the primary source of global risk spillovers, while the Chinese stock market is primarily a net receiver of risk.
abstract_zh: 探究国际原油价格与股票市场之间的动态关联对于缓解跨市场系统性风险至关重要。基于2002年1月11日至2023年10月13日的周度数据，本文构建了融合小波分解、DCC-GARCH模型及分位数时频溢出方法的综合分析框架，系统考察了石油-股票市场的关联机制。主要发现如下：第一，油价与股票收益的相关性呈现显著频率依赖性。短期表现为正相关，而长期则转为负相关。第二，油价变动与股票市场的关系随油价冲击的驱动因素不同而存在差异。需求驱动的油价上涨主要伴随正相关，而供给驱动的油价上涨则更多呈现负相关。第三，VIX指数与市场联动性呈正相关，而GPR指数则呈现相反效应。第四，油价与美国股市的相关性强于其与中国股市的相关性，这或可归因于中国的政策干预及市场结构差异。此外，美国股市是全球风险溢出的主要来源，而中国股市则主要扮演风险净接收者的角色。

title: Dynamic linkage and risk transmission mechanisms between crude oil and China – U.S. stock markets: a multi-scale perspective
title_zh: 原油与中美股市的动态联动及风险传导机制：多尺度视角

abstract: The Government Green Fund (GGF) has emerged as an important policy instrument for promoting green and low-carbon development and advancing the broader green transformation of the economy and society. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2022, this study manually collects firm-level GGF data and employs a difference-in-differences (DID) approach to evaluate the impact of GGF on enterprise green transformation (EGT). The results indicate that GGF significantly promotes EGT. Further channel analyses suggest that the effect of GGF is consistent with two potential channels: green signalling and the alleviation of financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the effect of GGF on EGT is more pronounced among firms in non-heavily polluting industries, non-state-owned enterprises, and non-growth-stage firms. Furthermore, GGF has a significantly stronger effect in regions with greater government fundraising capacity, and its positive effect on EGT is statistically more significant in regions with lower government environmental attention. In addition, GGF has a stronger effect in non-key support industries. Accordingly, efforts should be made to improve the incentive compatibility mechanism of GGF investment and to implement differentiated investment strategies to enhance the efficiency of capital allocation.
abstract_zh: 政府绿色基金（GGF）已成为推动绿色低碳发展、促进经济社会全面绿色转型的重要政策工具。本文以2010—2022年中国A股上市公司为样本，手工收集企业层面GGF数据，采用双重差分法（DID）评估GGF对企业绿色转型（EGT）的影响。结果表明，GGF显著促进了企业绿色转型。进一步渠道分析表明，GGF的作用与绿色信号传递和融资约束缓解两个潜在渠道一致。异质性分析进一步揭示，GGF对非重污染行业企业、非国有企业及非成长期企业的绿色转型效应更为显著。此外，在政府筹资能力更强的地区，GGF的促进作用更为突出；而在政府环境关注度较低的地区，GGF对EGT的正向效应在统计上更为显著。同时，GGF在非重点支持行业中的效应更强。据此，应完善GGF投资的激励相容机制，并实施差异化投资策略以提升资本配置效率。

title: Government-led green finance and enterprise green transformation: an empirical study of China’s government green fund policy
title_zh: 政府引导的绿色金融与企业绿色转型：基于中国政府绿色基金政策的实证研究

abstract: This paper investigates the role of central bank verbal communication in China’s foreign exchange market, focusing on the coordination channel through which communication influences exchange rate dynamics and market expectations. We develop a heterogeneous agent model where fundamentalists’ confidence depends on exchange rate misalignment and central bank communication. The model indicates that verbal communication can strengthen market coordination and accelerate the exchange rate’s reversion towards its fundamental value. Empirically, we construct a novel index related to central bank verbal communication based on official statements and examine its effects using a Smooth Transition Regression GARCH (STR-GARCH) model. Our results show that PBOC verbal communication is associated with changes in exchange rate dynamics and volatility, consistent with the coordination mechanism. We conduct a series of robustness checks and address potential endogeneity concerns arising from the central bank’s reaction to market conditions. This study contributes to the literature on foreign exchange intervention and expectation management by providing new evidence on the role of verbal communication in a managed exchange rate regime.
abstract_zh: 本文研究中央银行口头沟通在中国外汇市场中的作用，重点关注沟通通过协调渠道影响汇率动态与市场预期的机制。我们构建了一个异质性主体模型，其中基本面交易者的信心取决于汇率失调程度与央行沟通。模型表明，口头沟通能够强化市场协调，加速汇率向基本面价值的回归。在实证层面，我们基于官方声明构建了央行口头沟通的新指数，并采用平滑转换回归GARCH（STR-GARCH）模型检验其影响。结果显示，中国人民银行的口头沟通与汇率动态及波动率变化存在关联，这与协调机制一致。我们进行了一系列稳健性检验，并处理了央行对市场状况反应可能引发的内生性问题。本研究通过提供管理浮动汇率制度下口头沟通作用的新证据，为外汇干预与预期管理领域的文献做出贡献。

title: Central bank verbal communication in China’s FX market: a nonlinear coordination channel approach
title_zh: 中国外汇市场中的央行口头沟通：一种非线性协调渠道方法

abstract: Growing demand for healthier beverages is driving innovation in the wine sector, with dealcoholized wine emerging as a promising alternative. However, little is known about the contextual conditions under which consumers would choose dealcoholized wine, particularly in countries with strong wine traditions. To fill this gap, this work examines how situational factors and information treatments influence consumers' willingness to switch from traditional to dealcoholized wine in Italy and Croatia, two countries with different wine consumption traditions. Using a vignette‐based experiment administered to 1600 wine consumers, this study analyses how consumption context and product information affect the likelihood of choosing dealcoholized wine over conventional alternatives. The results show that, although conventional wine remains the preferred option under standard conditions, the likelihood of switching to dealcoholized wine increases when a driving constraint is introduced. Informational treatments significantly affect choices in Italy, whereas Croatian consumers appear to respond more to functional constraints than to calorie or health messages. The findings have implications for producers and policymakers seeking to promote dealcoholized wines.
abstract_zh: 对更健康饮料的需求增长正推动葡萄酒行业创新，无醇葡萄酒正成为一种有前景的替代选择。然而，关于消费者在何种情境条件下会选择无醇葡萄酒，尤其是在具有深厚葡萄酒传统的国家，目前仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，本研究考察了情境因素和信息处理如何影响意大利和克罗地亚（两个具有不同葡萄酒消费传统的国家）消费者从传统葡萄酒转向无醇葡萄酒的意愿。通过对1600名葡萄酒消费者进行基于情境实验的分析，本研究探讨了消费情境和产品信息如何影响选择无醇葡萄酒而非传统替代品的可能性。结果表明，尽管传统葡萄酒在标准条件下仍是首选，但当引入驾驶限制条件时，转向无醇葡萄酒的可能性增加。信息处理显著影响意大利消费者的选择，而克罗地亚消费者似乎对功能性限制的反应强于对卡路里或健康信息的反应。这些发现对寻求推广无醇葡萄酒的生产商和政策制定者具有启示意义。
title: Promoting Healthier Drinking: Evidence From a Vignette Experiment on Contextual and Informational Drivers of Dealcoholized Wine Choices
title_zh: 促进健康饮酒：情境与信息因素对无醇葡萄酒选择影响的场景实验证据

abstract: How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何影响政府支出冲击的传导机制及宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过影响工资刚性、岗位分离和匹配摩擦来作用于财政传导机制。基于16个OECD经济体的交互面板向量自回归模型估计，我们研究了宏观经济对政府支出冲击的反应如何随劳动力市场制度特征而变化。与理论预测一致，我们发现稳定就业和工资的制度倾向于降低产出波动，并削弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的反应。
title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
title_zh: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动

abstract: Does globalization weaken worker’s rights? Data is inconclusive; what evidence there is suggests a developing country tends to strengthen labor rights when its access to global value chains (GVC’s) increases. We present a stylized model of multinational firms choosing host locations for global value chains, in which each host-country government chooses the strength of collective-bargaining rights for its workers. Each government trades the direct benefit of stronger bargaining rights against the effect of chasing multinationals away to rival countries. We find that an increase in globalization in the sense of lower transaction costs has no effect on equilibrium workers’ rights, but lower costs for one country tend to strengthen that country’s labor rights, and adding more countries to the global economy tends, in the limit, to weaken them.
abstract_zh: 全球化是否会削弱工人的权利？现有数据尚无定论；已有的证据表明，当发展中国家融入全球价值链（GVCs）的程度提高时，其往往倾向于加强劳动权利。我们构建了一个模型，描述跨国公司选择全球价值链东道国位置的过程，其中每个东道国政府决定其工人集体谈判权利的强度。每个政府都在加强谈判权利的直接利益与将跨国公司驱赶至竞争对手国家的影响之间进行权衡。我们发现，以降低交易成本为表现的全球化增强，对均衡状态下的工人权利没有影响；但某一国家成本的降低倾向于加强该国的劳动权利，而全球经济中增加更多国家，在极限情况下，则倾向于削弱这些权利。
title: Foreign direct investment, global value chains, and labor rights: No race-to-the-bottom?
title_zh: 外国直接投资、全球价值链与劳工权利：没有逐底竞争？

abstract: Despite decades of reform, early marriage and dowry remain pervasive in rural India. I examine whether women's political representation shifts these practices. I develop a model in which households choose daughters' marriage timing and dowry, facing social penalties for non-marriage. Female leaders, by expanding women's economic opportunities, increase the value of daughters and delay marriage. When social penalties are high, delays raise dowry. I test this using exogenous variation from India's 1992 constitutional amendment, which reserved one-third of village council (pradhan) seats for women. Data from a representative rural survey shows that female pradhans delay marriage by 1.22 years and increase dowry by 68%. A 29% rise in female labor force participation partly explains the delay. Dowry increases are concentrated in patriarchal states, where penalties for non-marriage are most severe. The findings highlight both the potential and the limits of political empowerment in transforming marital norms under binding social constraints.
abstract_zh: 尽管历经数十年改革，童婚与嫁妆在印度农村地区依然普遍存在。本文考察女性政治代表权是否改变了这些习俗。我构建了一个模型，其中家庭在面临未婚的社会惩罚时，会选择女儿的结婚时机与嫁妆。女性领导人通过拓宽女性的经济机会，提升了女儿的价值并推迟了婚龄。当社会惩罚较高时，推迟婚龄会增加嫁妆。我利用印度1992年宪法修正案产生的外生变异进行检验，该修正案将村务委员会（pradhan）席位的三分之一保留给女性。来自代表性农村调查的数据显示，女性pradhan使婚龄推迟了1.22年，并使嫁妆增加了68%。女性劳动力参与率上升29%部分解释了这一推迟现象。嫁妆的增加集中在父权制邦，这些地区对未婚的社会惩罚最为严重。研究结果凸显了在刚性社会约束下，政治赋权在转变婚姻规范方面的潜力与局限。
title: Political empowerment and marital practices
title_zh: 政治赋权与婚姻实践

abstract: We examine how son preference affects women’s mental health across generations using original survey data from extended households in rural India. Leveraging exogenous variation in the sex of the firstborn child, we find that mothers-in-law (MILs) whose co-resident daughter-in-law (DIL) had a firstborn son face a 15 percent lower risk of anxiety or depression. In contrast, firstborn sex has no average effect on DIL mental health, although adverse effects of not having a son emerge among older DILs who face a closing reproductive window. We also find that a DIL’s firstborn son shifts MIL time allocation toward childcare and increases her support for DIL employment when children are young, boosting younger DILs’ labor force participation. These findings reveal an intergenerational pathway linking son preference to women’s mental health, intrahousehold dynamics, and economic outcomes beyond fertility alone.
abstract_zh: 我们利用印度农村扩展家庭的一手调查数据，考察了子女性别偏好如何跨代影响女性心理健康。通过利用头胎子女性别的外生变异，我们发现，与同住的儿媳（DIL）生育头胎为儿子的婆婆（MIL）相比，其焦虑或抑郁风险降低了15%。相反，头胎子女性别对儿媳的心理健康平均无显著影响，但在面临生育窗口即将关闭的年长儿媳中，未生育儿子带来的不利影响则显现出来。我们还发现，儿媳的头胎儿子使得婆婆将更多时间分配于照料孙辈，并在孩子年幼时增加对儿媳就业的支持，从而促进了年轻儿媳的劳动力参与。这些发现揭示了一条跨代路径，将子女性别偏好与女性心理健康、家庭内部动态及超越生育本身的经济结果联系起来。
title: Son preference, intergenerational household dynamics, and women’s mental health in India
title_zh: 子女性别偏好、代际家庭动态与印度女性心理健康

abstract: We analyze alternative agricultural carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) designs across three dimensions (participating countries, emission intensity, and carbon price). We find that an agricultural CBAM by the European Union (or an expanded climate club consisting of the EU and other countries) has minor global agricultural GHG emission implications but protects the most emission intensive domestic production. Nevertheless, having a larger climate club imposing CBAM tariffs and applying exporters’ emission intensities are more effective in lowering global emissions. Compared to national carbon prices, harmonized carbon prices at climate club level can reduce trade disruptions while attaining similar emission reduction outcomes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们从三个维度（参与国、排放强度与碳价格）分析了农业碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的不同设计方案。研究发现，欧盟（或由欧盟及其他国家组成的扩大化气候俱乐部）实施的农业CBAM对全球农业温室气体排放影响较小，但能保护国内排放强度最高的生产活动。然而，由更大规模的气候俱乐部征收CBAM关税并采用出口国排放强度的方案，在降低全球排放方面更为有效。相较于各国自主设定的碳价格，在气候俱乐部层面实施统一的碳价格可在实现相近减排效果的同时减少贸易扭曲。
title: Alternative Agricultural Carbon Border Adjustment and Climate Club Designs : a Quantitative Assessment
title_zh: 替代性农业碳边境调节与气候俱乐部设计：一项量化评估

abstract: This paper examines the impact of China’s nationwide Poverty Alleviation Relocation Program (PARP) on cropland abandonment. Utilizing four waves of household panel data across eight provinces, we exploit the staggered timing of relocations among households to identify its consequences on cropland use in origin villages. Our findings show that relocation increases cropland abandonment ratio by 7 percentage points. The observed changes in cropland use reflect relocated households’ rational behavior, driven by increased off-farm employment opportunities and higher farming costs in origin villages. Effects are more pronounced for households with steeper or lower-quality land, those resettled in urban areas, and those from villages not designated as national poor villages. Further analysis indicates that the Grain-for-Green program, along with agricultural industrial development projects and land rental policy, can help mitigate potential pressures on cropland abandonment. We then proposea typology-based framework to optimize land use policies across heterogeneous out-migration regions, aiming to support sustainable rural transformation in post-relocation contexts. Our findings highlight that PARP involves inherent trade-offs between local grain production, poverty alleviation, and ecological restoration.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国全国性易地扶贫搬迁项目（PARP）对耕地撂荒的影响。利用覆盖八个省份的四轮农户面板数据，我们利用农户间搬迁时间的交错性来识别其对迁出村耕地利用的因果效应。研究发现，搬迁使耕地撂荒比例提高了7个百分点。观察到的耕地利用变化反映了搬迁农户的理性行为，其驱动因素包括非农就业机会的增加以及迁出村耕作成本的上升。对于拥有坡度较大或质量较差土地的农户、迁入城镇安置的农户以及来自未被认定为国家贫困村的农户，该效应更为显著。进一步分析表明，退耕还林工程、农业产业化发展项目及土地流转政策有助于缓解耕地撂荒的潜在压力。随后，我们提出一个基于类型学的框架，以优化异质性人口迁出地区的土地利用政策，旨在支持搬迁后情境下的可持续农村转型。我们的研究结果强调，PARP在地方粮食生产、扶贫与生态恢复之间内含着固有的权衡取舍。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Cropland use consequences of a nationwide poverty alleviation relocation program in China
title_zh: 中国全国性扶贫搬迁计划对耕地利用的影响

abstract: In 1900, thousands of people in England were poisoned by arsenic. The source was beer contaminated by tainted sugar. This paper examines how the poisoning affected birth rates in the affected areas, using an event study difference-in-difference design. The results show that the arsenic-in-beer epidemic caused a 10% drop in births in 1901, but the effect was short-lived. After about 28 weeks, birth rates returned to pre-epidemic levels. Evidence from the timing of the effect and a range of alternative mechanisms is most consistent with the epidemic reducing conceptions or early pregnancies, rather than operating through economic disruption or later gestational harm.
abstract_zh: 1900年，英格兰数千人因砷中毒而受害，其源头为被污染糖所掺杂的啤酒。本文采用事件研究双重差分设计，探讨了此次中毒事件对受影响地区出生率的影响。结果显示，1901年啤酒砷中毒疫情导致出生率下降10%，但此效应短暂，约28周后，出生率恢复至疫情前水平。基于效应时间点及一系列替代机制的证据，最符合的解释是疫情减少了受孕或早期妊娠，而非通过经济干扰或妊娠后期伤害发挥作用。
title: Arsenic and fertility: Evidence from the 1900 English beer-poisoning epidemic
title_zh: 砷与生育力：来自1900年英国啤酒中毒流行病的证据

abstract: We study the early-life determinants of children’s perseverance and its predictive power for educational attainment and labour market outcomes across the life course. Using teacher-assessed perseverance from the 1970 British Cohort Study we document that cognitive skills, gender, early health, and parental influences (particularly maternal biological factors and paternal education) are the strongest predictors of perseverance at age 10. Perseverance and cognitive skills exhibit distinct yet complementary effects on later outcomes. Perseverance shows strong associations with academic self-perception, internal locus of control, and interpersonal workplace skills such as teamwork, while cognitive skills dominate in technical and numerical domains. We assess the credibility of these associations, by combining Augmented Inverse Propensity Weighting with the framework of Cinelli and Hazlett (2020), quantifying how strong unobserved confounding would need to be to overturn our findings. This analysis reveals that perseverance’s associations with contemporaneous academic performance and locus of control beliefs show strong to moderate robustness. In contrast, associations with educational attainment and labour market outcomes are more fragile. Subgroup analysis reveals that perseverance functions as a compensatory mechanism in the face of childhood adversity, and it reinforces effort beliefs and labour market outcomes for males. Our findings would imply that policies promoting perseverance yield credible benefits for academic engagement and psychological well-being, but long-term economic gains requires interventions addressing educational access, financial barriers and labour market inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了儿童早期坚持性的决定因素及其在生命历程中对教育成就和劳动力市场结果的预测力。利用1970年英国队列研究中教师评估的坚持性，我们记录了认知技能、性别、早期健康以及父母影响（尤其是母亲生物学因素和父亲教育程度）是10岁时坚持性的最强预测因子。坚持性与认知技能在后续结果上表现出独特且互补的效应。坚持性与学术自我认知、内在控制点以及人际工作场所技能（如团队合作）密切相关，而认知技能在技术和数值领域占主导地位。我们通过将增强逆概率加权与Cinelli和Hazlett（2020）的框架相结合，评估了这些关联的可信度，量化了未观测混杂因素需要多强才能推翻我们的发现。分析显示，坚持性与同期学业表现和控制点信念的关联表现出强至中等的稳健性。相比之下，与教育成就和劳动力市场结果的关联则较为脆弱。亚组分析揭示，坚持性在面对童年逆境时起到补偿机制的作用，并强化了男性的努力信念和劳动力市场结果。我们的发现意味着，促进坚持性的政策对学术参与和心理健康产生可信的益处，但长期经济收益需要干预措施来解决教育机会、财务障碍和劳动力市场不平等问题。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Perseverance, cognitive skills and life outcomes
title_zh: 毅力、认知技能与人生结果

abstract: A firm may decide to make total-surplus-reducing purchase recommendations in response to consumer heterogeneity in an experience good setting with endogenous prices. First, we show under which conditions the firm chooses to make such biased recommendations in a monopoly setting. Second, we propose a duopoly model with differentiated products in which single-product firms compete in uniform prices and recommendation policies. We establish when and why both firms bias their recommendations. This bias can disappear when the market becomes less competitive, one firm exits, or both firms merge.
abstract_zh: 在体验品市场中，面对内生价格与消费者异质性，企业可能选择做出降低总剩余的购买推荐。首先，我们展示了在垄断情境下，企业选择做出此类有偏推荐的条件。其次，我们提出一个差异化产品的双寡头模型，其中单一产品企业在统一定价和推荐策略下竞争。我们确定了双方企业何时以及为何会偏向其推荐。当市场竞争减弱、一家企业退出或两家企业合并时，这种偏差可能消失。
title: Recommendation power and competition
title_zh: 推荐力与竞争

abstract: We compare two procedures for the iterated removal of strictly dominated strategies. In the nested procedure, a strategy of a player is removed only if it is dominated by an unremoved strategy. The universal procedure is more comprehensive for it allows the removal of strategies that are dominated by previously removed ones. Outside the class of finite games, the two procedures may lead to different outcomes in that the universal one is always order independent while the other is not. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the equivalence of the two procedures. The conditions we give are based on completely bounded subsets of strategy profiles, which are variations of the bounded mechanisms from the literature on full implementation. The two elimination procedures are also shown to be equivalent in quasisupermodular games as well as in games with compact strategy spaces and upper semicontinuous payoff functions. Finally, we give an example of a game in which the nested procedure is order independent but not equivalent to the universal one, thus showing that order independence is not sufficient to guarantee the equivalence of the two elimination procedures.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了两种严格占优策略迭代剔除的程序。在嵌套程序中，只有当某个玩家的策略被一个未被剔除的策略所支配时，该策略才会被移除。通用程序则更为全面，因为它允许移除那些被先前已剔除策略所支配的策略。在有限博弈类之外，这两种程序可能导致不同的结果，即通用程序总是顺序无关的，而嵌套程序则不然。我们提供了这两种程序等价性的必要且充分条件。所给出的条件基于策略组合的完全有界子集，这些是完整实施文献中受限机制的变体。此外，我们还证明了这两种剔除程序在拟超模博弈以及具有紧策略空间和上半连续支付函数的博弈中是等价的。最后，我们给出了一个博弈示例，其中嵌套程序是顺序无关的，但与通用程序不等价，从而表明顺序无关性并不足以保证这两种剔除程序的等价性。
title: Nested removal of strictly dominated strategies in infinite games
title_zh: 无限博弈中严格占优策略的嵌套剔除

abstract: We investigate input price discrimination under secret contracting between a manufacturer and competing retailers, whose investment activities exhibit retail effort spillovers. We show that the economic effects of input price discrimination vary with the sign and magnitude of retail effort spillovers according to the contractual structure, namely, linear or two‐part tariffs. Retail effort spillovers and product differentiation affect the pass‐through of input price to retail quantity, which is defined under each contractual structure. Our analysis provides novel insights into the role of retail effort spillovers and into the evaluation of quantity pass‐through in the antitrust scrutiny of input price discrimination.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了制造商与竞争性零售商之间秘密合同下的投入品价格歧视问题，其中零售商的投资活动存在零售努力溢出效应。研究表明，投入品价格歧视的经济效应随零售努力溢出的正负及大小而变化，且这种变化取决于合同结构（线性关税或两部收费制）。零售努力溢出与产品差异化会影响投入品价格向零售数量的传导效应，该传导效应在不同合同结构下具有不同定义。本文分析为理解零售努力溢出的作用机制，以及反垄断审查中评估数量传导效应对投入品价格歧视的影响提供了全新视角。
title: Input Price Discrimination: The Role of Retail Effort Spillovers
title_zh: 投入品价格歧视：零售努力溢出效应的作用

abstract: Reducing gender-specific commuting barriers in developing countries can have heterogeneous effects on women’s labor outcomes. We study a program that offers free bus rides for women in several Indian states (the Pink Slip program) using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach to examine impacts on transportation expenditures, time use, and labor supply. We find that the program substantially reduces bus-related expenditures. However, when considering all women together, we find no significant changes in travel time, household production, or labor supply. Beneath these aggregate effects, responses vary sharply by employment, marital status, and education. Unmarried women employed prior to the policy increase labor supply, while married women with low and medium levels of education reallocate time away from paid work toward household chores. Overall employment rates remain unchanged in the short run, highlighting that reducing commuting costs does not uniformly improve women’s labor market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 在发展中国家，减少针对性别差异的通勤障碍可能对女性的劳动结果产生异质性影响。我们利用合成双重差分法，研究印度多个邦实施的女性免费公交乘车计划（“粉红票”计划），分析其对交通支出、时间利用和劳动供给的影响。研究发现，该计划显著降低了与公交相关的支出。然而，从全体女性来看，通勤时间、家务生产或劳动供给并未发生显著变化。在这些总体效应之下，不同群体的反应因就业状况、婚姻状况和教育水平而存在显著差异。政策实施前已有工作的未婚女性增加了劳动供给，而中低教育水平的已婚女性则将时间从有偿工作转向家务劳动。总体就业率在短期内保持不变，这表明降低通勤成本并不能一致地改善女性的劳动力市场结果。
title:
Gender-Specific Transportation Costs and Female Time Use: Evidence from India’s
                    Pink Slip
                    Program
title_zh: 性别特定交通成本与女性时间利用：来自印度“粉色车票”项目的证据

abstract: Mobile money platforms are ubiquitous in many emerging economies. Hailed for raising financial inclusion and economic wellbeing, governments have now turned to mobile payments as a source of tax revenue. Transaction levies are often regressive, unpopular, and can encourage a return to cash. We present experimental evidence that they may also harm tax morale, a core component of the social contract between citizen and state. We present results from a survey experiment in Ghana, in which priming a controversial mobile transaction levy significantly lowers support for the state’s right to collect taxes and willingness to comply with tax laws. We combine this with focus group discussions and analyse effect heterogeneity to examine two pre-registered explanations: transaction taxes cost citizens more than they expect to gain (reciprocity) and provoke particular backlash from non-government voters (partisanship). Our findings suggest that taxing mobile money can undermine efforts to expand fiscal capacity, while raising important mechanistic and policy questions for future research.
abstract_zh: 移动货币平台在许多新兴经济体中无处不在。因其提升金融包容性和经济福祉而备受赞誉，各国政府现已转向移动支付作为税收来源。交易税往往具有累退性，不受欢迎，并可能促使人们回归现金使用。我们提供的实验证据表明，这类税收还可能损害税收道德，而税收道德是公民与国家之间社会契约的核心组成部分。我们展示了在加纳进行的一项调查实验结果，其中，引入一项有争议的移动交易税显著降低了公众对国家征税权的支持度以及遵守税法的意愿。我们将此与焦点小组讨论相结合，并分析效应异质性，以检验两项预先注册的解释：交易税给公民带来的成本超过其预期收益（互惠性），以及引发非政府选民特别强烈的反弹（党派性）。我们的研究结果表明，对移动货币征税可能削弱扩大财政能力的努力，同时为未来研究提出了重要的机制性和政策性问题。
title: Mobile money and the social contract: Experimental evidence from Ghana
title_zh: 移动货币与社会契约：来自加纳的实验证据

abstract: Ten years of idiosyncratic variation in school closure dates for all secondary schools in England are combined with administrative records of educational and criminal trajectories linked at the individual level to study the impact of the school schedule on the dynamics of youth crime. When school is not in session, students commit more property offences, more serious violent offences and fewer minor violent offences. Increased thefts, robberies and violent assaults drive these effects. This is novel evidence of strong multiple crime effects that arise from the protective factor of schooling and which affect not only the incidence of violence, but also its severity and its targets.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英格兰所有中学十年间因特殊原因导致的停课日期变化，结合个体层面关联的教育与犯罪轨迹行政记录，研究学校作息安排对青少年犯罪动态的影响。当学校停课时，学生实施的财产犯罪、严重暴力犯罪增加，而轻微暴力犯罪减少。盗窃、抢劫和暴力袭击的增加是导致这些效应的主要原因。本研究首次提供了强有力的多重犯罪效应证据，这些效应源于学校教育的保护性因素，不仅影响暴力犯罪的发生率，还影响其严重程度及目标对象。
title: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
title_zh: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为

abstract: Forest fires pose a significant threat to ecological stability, particularly in climatically vulnerable and topographically complex regions like Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. This study aims to identify the key environmental and anthropogenic drivers of fire occurrence in the Hazara Division and to evaluate the predictive performance of machine learning models for spatial susceptibility mapping. We hypothesize that climatic variability, vegetation conditions, and anthropogenic accessibility collectively influence forest fire distribution patterns, while elevation serves as an indirect spatial indicator of these environmental gradients. This research aims to comparatively evaluate the predictive performance of four machine learning classifiers: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), XGBoost, and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) for forest fire susceptibility mapping. A dataset of 2100 georeferenced points (1050 fire and 1050 non-fire) was used, and 34 predictors were initially considered, compiled from four thematic domains: topographic (elevation, slope, landforms, etc.), vegetation based Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Net Primary Productivity (NPP), Leaf area index (LAI), etc., climatic (Rainfall, Temperature maximum (Tmax), Temperature minimum (Tmin), Soil moisture (SM)), and anthropogenic (Distance to roads, settlements, waterways). After multicollinearity analysis using the Variance Inflation Factor (VIF < 5), 13 key predictors were retained. Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis revealed that among the evaluated classifiers, RF achieved the highest predictive performance (AUC = 0.90), followed by SVM (AUC = 0.87), XGBoost (AUC = 0.86), and GBM (AUC = 0.85). RF and XGBoost demonstrated comparatively stronger responses to topographic and vegetation indices, while SVM showed a stronger response to climatic parameters. Across all models, elevation, anthropogenic factor, and temperature consistently ranked among the top predictors, validating the importance of terrain and human proximity. Spatial results indicate that lower-elevation peri-urban forest margins in southern Hazara exhibit higher susceptibility. While the modelling framework demonstrates strong predictive capability, uncertainties may arise from satellite-based fire detection accuracy and differences in spatial resolution among environmental predictors. The resulting susceptibility maps provide a practical decision-support tool for targeted mitigation and improved forest management planning.
abstract_zh: 森林火灾对生态稳定性构成重大威胁，尤其是在气候脆弱、地形复杂的地区，如巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省。本研究旨在识别哈扎拉地区火灾发生的关键环境和人为驱动因素，并评估机器学习模型在空间敏感性制图中的预测性能。我们假设气候变异性、植被条件和人为可达性共同影响森林火灾的分布格局，而海拔作为这些环境梯度的间接空间指标。本研究旨在比较评估四种机器学习分类器——随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）、XGBoost和梯度提升机（GBM）——在森林火灾敏感性制图中的预测性能。研究使用了2100个地理参考点（1050个火灾点和1050个非火灾点）的数据集，初步考虑了34个预测因子，涵盖四个主题域：地形（海拔、坡度、地貌等）、基于归一化差异植被指数（NDVI）、净初级生产力（NPP）、叶面积指数（LAI）等的植被因子、气候因子（降雨量、最高温度（Tmax）、最低温度（Tmin）、土壤湿度（SM））以及人为因子（距道路、居民点、水道的距离）。经过使用方差膨胀因子（VIF < 5）进行的多重共线性分析后，保留了13个关键预测因子。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析显示，在所评估的分类器中，RF取得了最高的预测性能（AUC = 0.90），其次是SVM（AUC = 0.87）、XGBoost（AUC = 0.86）和GBM（AUC = 0.85）。RF和XGBoost对地形和植被指数表现出相对较强的响应，而SVM对气候参数表现出更强的响应。在所有模型中，海拔、人为因子和温度始终位列最重要的预测因子之列，验证了地形和人类邻近性的重要性。空间结果表明，哈扎拉南部低海拔城郊森林边缘区域表现出较高的敏感性。尽管该建模框架展现出较强的预测能力，但卫星火灾探测精度以及各环境预测因子间空间分辨率的差异可能带来不确定性。所生成的敏感性图为有针对性的减缓措施和改进的森林管理规划提供了实用的决策支持工具。
title: Artificial intelligence-driven forest fire land susceptibility mapping: A remote sensing and machine learning approach
title_zh: 基于人工智能的森林火灾土地易感性制图：遥感与机器学习方法

abstract: We study how macroeconomic developments affect asset prices by analyzing the response of equity yields to a well-identified long-run growth shock. Using synthetic equity yield data from Giglio et al. (2024), we show that a positive long-run shock steepens the equity yield curve by increasing expected dividend growth while leaving discount rates largely unchanged. We examine how the investment driving this growth is financed and how yields respond across value and growth firms. Growth-firm yields respond more strongly than value-firm yields, reflecting larger changes in expected dividend growth. Ai et al. (2018)’s model, modified to separate cash dividends from total payout, best matches these responses relative to benchmark equity term structure models.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析股票收益率对明确识别的长期增长冲击的反应，研究宏观经济变化如何影响资产价格。利用Giglio等人（2024）的合成股票收益率数据，我们发现正向长期冲击通过提高预期股息增长率使股票收益率曲线陡峭化，而贴现率基本保持不变。我们考察了驱动这一增长的投资融资方式，以及价值型与成长型公司收益率的差异化反应。成长型公司收益率对冲击的反应强于价值型公司，这反映了其预期股息增长率的更大变化。相较于基准股票期限结构模型，Ai等人（2018）的模型（经修正以分离现金股息与总派息）最能匹配这些反应特征。
title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock
title_zh: 股权收益率对长期冲击的反应

abstract: Focus Stablecoins – cryptoassets designed to maintain a stable value relative to a reference asset, most commonly the US dollar – have become the dominant medium of exchange within the crypto ecosystem. Their market capitalisation has expanded rapidly in recent years and is forecast to expand further, though projections vary widely. While a growing literature examines their implications for payment and financial systems, the macroeconomic consequences of broader stablecoin adoption remain underexplored.
abstract_zh: 焦点稳定币——旨在相对于参考资产（最常见的是美元）维持稳定价值的加密资产——已成为加密生态系统内的主导交换媒介。尽管预测差异较大，但其市值近年来迅速扩张，并预计将进一步增长。虽然越来越多的文献探讨了稳定币对支付和金融体系的影响，但更广泛采用稳定币的宏观经济后果仍未得到充分研究。
title: The macroeconomics of stablecoins
title_zh: 稳定币的宏观经济学

abstract: We study the pricing of bank deposits in the Euro area during 2007--2024. We document that the pass-through of policy rates to sight deposit rates is low, asymmetric, varies across countries, and decreases over time. We estimate an equilibrium model of bank deposit markets, and find that depositors' price sensitivity exhibits large heterogeneity across EU markets and over time. Rate-sensitive depositors switched to higher-yielding savings products, decreasing the rate-sensitivity of the remaining pool of sight deposits and increasing banks' market power, accounting for the sluggish pass-through following the 2022 European Central Bank's rate hikes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2007至2024年欧元区银行存款的定价机制。我们记录到，政策利率向活期存款利率的传导呈现低水平、非对称性、跨国差异显著且随时间递减的特征。通过构建银行存款市场均衡模型进行估计，发现存款人的价格敏感度在欧盟各市场及不同时期存在显著异质性。对利率敏感的存款人转向收益率更高的储蓄产品，导致剩余活期存款池的利率敏感度下降，银行市场势力增强，这解释了2022年欧洲央行加息后传导机制迟滞的现象。
title: Bank Deposit Pricing in the Euro Area
title_zh: 欧元区银行存款定价

abstract: Ransomware groups vary in the types of organizations they compromise, yet little empirical work has examined whether these differences extend to the technology stacks of victims. We analyze 5,190 ransomware incidents across 151 groups, linking each victim to its observed technology stack from the SWDB Company Intelligence database. We find that some enterprise software is associated with greater ransomware risk than others, and that this association is often stronger for technologies carrying more known vulnerabilities. Next, by analyzing leaked chat logs of leading ransomware groups, we present direct evidence that some groups choose their victims based on observed technology use and revenue data gathered through opensource intelligence. Finally, examining the full population of victims, we find that some groups concentrate on particular technologies and revenue profiles, while others appear more opportunistic, with a victim profile close to the overall population.
abstract_zh: 勒索软件团伙在选择攻击目标时，其针对的组织类型存在差异，但鲜有实证研究探讨这些差异是否延伸至受害者的技术栈。我们分析了151个团伙涉及的5,190起勒索软件事件，将每个受害者与SWDB公司情报数据库中观测到的技术栈进行关联。研究发现，部分企业软件面临的勒索软件风险高于其他软件，且这种关联在已知漏洞较多的技术中往往更为显著。进一步通过分析主要勒索软件团伙泄露的聊天记录，我们提供了直接证据，表明部分团伙会基于开源情报收集到的技术使用情况和收入数据来选择受害者。最后，通过对全部受害者群体的分析，我们发现部分团伙专注于特定技术和收入特征，而其他团伙则更具机会主义倾向，其受害者特征与整体群体相近。
title: How do ransomware groups choose their targets? An empirical analysis
title_zh: 勒索软件组织如何选择攻击目标？一项实证分析

abstract: Proxy advisors play a central and controversial role in modern corporate governance. Institutional investors rely on advisory firms such as Institutional Shareholder Services and Glass Lewis to provide shareholder voting recommendations, research, and execution infrastructure across thousands of portfolio companies each year, enabling voting at scale. Critics argue that proxy advisors induce “robo-voting,” exercise excessive influence, operate with conflicts of interest, and dominate a concentrated market with limited accountability. In response, federal and state actors have launched an escalating series of investigations, executive actions, and novel statutory and regulatory regimes. Many existing reform proposals misdiagnose the economic foundations of proxy advice and risk degrading voting quality or driving proxy advisors from the market altogether. Because institutional investors have limited attention budgets, weakening proxy advisory services would likely increase deference to corporate management rather than enhance shareholder oversight. This Article offers an economic framework for evaluating proxy advice and the reforms proposed to regulate it. We develop a three-stage theory of shareholder voting in which investors (1) select proxy advisors, (2) specify customized voting policies ex ante, and (3) allocate scarce attention across proposals ex post. We complement this framework with empirical evidence on voting patterns that reassesses claims of “robo-voting” and advisor dominance. Together, our analysis situates proxy advice within the collective-action problem inherent in shareholder voting: investors bear the concentrated costs of informed voting while capturing only a fraction of its benefits. Building on this analysis, we propose a targeted reform agenda. First, we recommend requiring proxy advisors to provide “attention flags” identifying recommendations that involve material trade-offs, firm-specific context, or high-stakes decisions, thereby directing investor attention to where it is most valuable. Second, we propose strengthening fiduciary obligations governing proxy voting to ensure meaningful engagement where warranted. We also address firm-specific conflicts of interest and evaluate prominent regulatory approaches, including federal solicitation-based regulation and recent state legislation. Our regulatory framework improves the targeting of investor attention while preserving economies of scale, offering a more promising path forward.
abstract_zh: 代理顾问在现代公司治理中扮演着核心且备受争议的角色。机构投资者依赖诸如机构股东服务公司和格拉斯·刘易斯等咨询公司，每年为数千家投资组合公司提供股东投票建议、研究及执行基础设施，从而实现规模化投票。批评者认为，代理顾问诱导“机器人投票”，施加过度影响，存在利益冲突，并在一个集中度高且问责有限的市场中占据主导地位。作为回应，联邦和州层面的行动者已发起一系列不断升级的调查、行政措施以及新的法规和监管制度。许多现有改革方案误判了代理建议的经济基础，可能降低投票质量，甚至将代理顾问完全逐出市场。由于机构投资者的注意力预算有限，削弱代理咨询服务可能会增加对管理层决策的顺从，而非增强股东监督。本文提供了一个评估代理建议及其监管改革的经济学框架。我们构建了一个股东投票的三阶段理论：投资者（1）选择代理顾问，（2）事先制定定制化投票政策，以及（3）事后在提案之间分配稀缺注意力。我们通过投票模式的实证证据补充这一框架，重新评估了关于“机器人投票”和顾问主导地位的论断。综合来看，我们的分析将代理建议置于股东投票中固有的集体行动问题中：投资者承担知情投票的集中成本，却仅获得其收益的一小部分。基于此分析，我们提出了一项有针对性的改革议程。首先，我们建议要求代理顾问提供“注意力标记”，识别涉及重大权衡、公司特定背景或高风险决策的建议，从而将投资者注意力引导至最有价值的领域。其次，我们提议加强管理代理投票的受托责任，以确保在必要时进行有意义的参与。我们还处理了公司特定的利益冲突，并评估了主要的监管方法，包括联邦基于招股说明书的监管和近期的州立法。我们的监管框架在保留规模经济的同时，改善了投资者注意力的针对性，提供了一条更有前景的前进道路。
title: Other people’s votes: The law and economics of proxy advice
title_zh: 他人之票：代理投票建议的法律与经济学
